scope: Only selected column names/types/nullability on two native work-order child tables. No business/Auth rows, stored-function bodies, private objects or server files; no SQL write or schema change.
query: SELECT a.attrelid::regclass::text AS table_name, a.attname AS column_name, pg_catalog.format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS data_type, a.attnotnull AS not_null FROM pg_catalog.pg_attribute AS a WHERE a.attrelid IN ('shop_manager.work_order_job_lines'::regclass, 'shop_manager.work_order_parts'::regclass) AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped AND a.attname IN ('name','part_name','hours','estimated_hours','labor_rate','total','total_amount','price','customer_price','quantity','part_type') ORDER BY table_name, column_name LIMIT 25;
finding: Current quote conversion sends job-line hours/total rather than estimated_hours/total_amount and part name/price/total rather than part_name/customer_price, omitting required part_type. Requested names absent from the returned rows were not columns in these observed tables; this is not a full column inventory. No conversion was executed.
limits: Column metadata and source mismatch only; no full schema/default/trigger/ACL/API/RLS/transaction behavior established.
